signals_meta.rules: Entry = the live price when the stock entered the list; Stop loss = the lower of today's low and Entry − 1 × ATR(14); Target 1 = Entry + 2 × risk, capped at the previous 20 sessions' high; Target 2 = Entry + 3 × risk; a plan is shown only when Target 1 is at least 1.5 × the risk away (falling F&O stocks in the Open interest lists: the short mirror).
signals_meta.caveat: Rule-based levels from fixed settings (scan-plan-v1), frozen when the signal was recorded. Not investment advice; no accuracy or hit rate is claimed. A stop loss is a level, not an executable price: an order can fill worse in a gap.
